coverage.method: Sitemap/navigation discovery, page-family HTML/CSS inspection, selected browser screenshots and runtime probes where permitted.
coverage.viewports: 1440px desktop and 390px mobile; not every source page was rendered.
coverage.limits: Public page families sampled, not every article, locale, private app or interaction state. Source-only theme/motion declarations are not runtime verification.

color.palette_type: monochromatic neutrals + single blue accent, with a full multi-hue primitive ramp reserved for illustration and badges

primary.role: Current Tatami primary-button background; blue-500 #097fe8 remains a separate primitive/accent.

secondary.role: headline text, dark sections, logo ink (gray-900)

accent.role: Blue soft action/mention surface; hero keyword chips also cycle through yellow, green and other campaign accents.

neutral.usage: warm-biased grays: #fff page ground, gray-100/200 section tints and cards, gray-500 muted text, gray-900 ink; alpha-black/white ramps (5%–95%) for borders and overlays

color.contrast_strategy: high contrast dark-on-light; near-black ink on white with only the blue accent saturated; dark inverted sections use alpha-white text ramps

typography.fonts: NotionInter/Inter for marketing; iA Writer Mono/Nitti for code; Lyon Text for editorial and Permanent Marker for handwritten accents are separate source roles.
typography.marketing: Mobile home h1 42/48, weight 600, tracking -1.5px. Pricing h1 64/64, weight 700, tracking -2.125px; group headings 32/40, weight 700, tracking -0.75px.
typography.body: 16/24 inherited; hero supporting copy larger. Navigation and CTAs use medium/semibold sans.
typography.source_scale: 12,14,16,18,20,22,26,32,42,54,64,76,96px Tatami scale; do not treat every page h1 as the same size.

spacing.content_density: comfortable — roomy sections, but feature grids pack tighter than the hero
spacing.section_rhythm: large uniform vertical bands; alternating white and gray-100/gray-200 tinted sections; occasional dark inverted band

layout.marketing: Oversized centered headline with changing inline verb chip, supporting sentence and CTA pair; product board below with ink characters and a logo marquee.
layout.pricing: 64px headline followed by two broad groups: a neutral Free/Plus group and a pale-blue Business/Enterprise group. Each holds two plans; this is not four unrelated floating cards.
layout.mobile: 42px headline; illustration medallions move above it, full-width primary CTA and hamburger navigation; product proof is rearranged for a narrow viewport.
layout.content: Editorial, templates, help and product routes share Tatami primitives but use different content rails and card arrangements.

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px alpha-black borders on cards and inputs; bold 2–3px colored circle strokes around illustration avatars
shape.divider_style: hairline alpha-black-200; sections mostly separated by background-tint changes instead of rules

levels.high: 3-layer stack up to ~18px blur, ≤2% alpha per layer (shadow-300)

elevation.depth_cues: background-tint changes and borders first; shadows only float product-UI windows and dropdowns

iconography.style: outlined UI icons plus hand-drawn ink spot illustrations
iconography.stroke_weight: 1.5px UI icons; variable brush weight in illustrations
iconography.preferred_set: Notion's in-house icon set; do not substitute a generic library when reproducing

motion.easing: ease-out for fades in, ease-in for fades out, cubic-bezier(0.76,0,0.24,1)/quint for transforms (motion-timing-function tokens)
motion.entrance_pattern: fade-in + slide-down for nav/menus; staggered enter animations in agent demo panels
motion.philosophy: minimal functional chrome motion, plus choreographed self-playing product demos (agent tasks, notification counters, logo marquee)

components.button_style: Primary #0075de, white medium/semibold text, moderate ~8px radius; secondary pale-blue fill with darker blue label. Pills belong to keyword highlights, badges and segmented billing controls.
components.card_style: Soft neutral or pale-blue group panels; 12–16px media/container radii, light alpha outlines and subtle shadows; pricing groups contain multiple plans.
components.navigation_pattern: Sticky white top bar with full mega-menu families; mobile logo + primary CTA + hamburger.
components.modal_style: white sheet, 12px radius, shadow-300, dimmed alpha-black overlay
components.list_style: arrow-suffixed link lists ('Docs → ', 'Projects → '); checklists inside product mock UI
components.component_notes: Badges come in bold/light/muted/outline variants driven by --color-accent-strong, which is re-themed per campaign section (blue, orange, purple, teal…). Product-UI windows with traffic lights serve as the imagery.

design_style.mood: Confident, friendly paper workspace: heavy sans statements, black ink characters and selective bright color.
design_style.composition: Large central headline and changing inline verb pill; product windows and cartoon faces are tightly composed together. Neutral shell allows campaign chips and product statuses to vary hue.
design_style.imagery: Hand-drawn faces/objects with halftone shading, product boards and agent workflows; photos belong chiefly to customer/editorial pages.
design_style.interaction: Quiet chrome around lively scripted product demos and a cycling headline. Avoid interpreting one frame as a permanently blue, static highlight.

visual_effects.technology: No canvas observed on homepage/pricing; CSS/DOM animation and media assets.
visual_effects.headline: Inline verb and colored pill change over time; observed Build/yellow and Ship/green among the states. This is not static blue highlighting.
visual_effects.scroll: Runtime includes navShadowScrolled and revealStickyBar animations with auto duration: scroll-timeline behavior is present, so the old blanket no-scroll-linked-effects claim is removed.
visual_effects.marquee: Customer-logo marquee observed at 60s linear infinite.
visual_effects.product: Scripted agent/task transitions, counters and media within product windows; static screenshots are only one part of the demonstration.
visual_effects.scope: No particle or 3D scene seen in the sampled marketing pages; unused bundles and separate campaigns are not covered by that absence claim.

page_families./: Rotating verb chip, product board, ink characters and persistent logo strip.
page_families./pricing: Two grouped plan panels, billing segmentation and dense feature comparison.
page_families./product/ai; /product/docs; /product/pro: Product-specific proof and campaign accents on shared Tatami primitives.
page_families./blog; /help: Editorial and support reading layouts; source checked separately from the landing.
